sentences.text: List revised.

2. No one appears on behalf of the applicants to press this application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. Sri Alok Kumar Kushwaha and Sri Anuj Kumar, learned counsels for the opposite party no.2 are also not present even when the matter is taken in the revised list.
Sri Birendra Pratap Singh, learned counsel for the State is present.

3. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants- Pawan,
Vishal, Sonu, Pappu and Sandhya, with the prayer to allow the present application and quash the entire proceeding as well as summoning order dated 13.03.2023 in Complaint Case No. 1852 of 2022, under sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S.

sentences.text: On 20.02.2025 the following order was passed by this Court:-
" 1 . List revised.

2. No one appears on behalf of the applicants to press this application u/s 482 Cr.P.C.
3.
Sri Alok Kumar Kushwaha, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and Sri Bade Lal Bind, learned counsel for State are present.

4. It is informed by learned members of the Bar present in the Court that there is again severe traffic jam in the city all over.
5.
Since there is no representation from the side of the applicants, in the interest of justice as a last opportunity, the matter is adjourned for today.

6. Let the matter be listed on 07.03.2025.
7.

It is made clear that the matter will not be adjourned on the next date as a matter of right."
5.
This Court had observed that as a last opportunity the matter is adjourned and it will not be adjourned on the next date as a matter of right.

6. The records further show that even prior to it on 01.08.2024 also there was no representation from the side of the applicants and the following order was passed by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court:-
"1.
None appears on behalf of the applicants even in the revised call.

However,
learned AGA for the State is present.
2. From the status report of the Mediation Centre, it appears that the mediation proceedings between the parties is still in process.

3. In view thereof, put up this matter on 12.9.2024 in the additional cause list.
4.
Interim order, if any, shall continue to operate till the next date of listing."
7. Since today again there is no representation from the side of the applicants, the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is dismissed for non prosecution.
